report_context_translation_list: The child is able to eat dissolvable foods independently, indicating well-developed oral motor skills for managing soft, melting textures without difficulty.
The child successfully eats soft foods, demonstrating effective oral motor control and coordination necessary for handling these textures.
The child is developing the ability to manage textured foods but may still experience occasional difficulty with maintaining control over these textures.
The child has not yet developed the skills to manage foods with lumps, suggesting challenges in transitioning to more complex textures.
The child effectively manages firm foods, showing mature oral motor abilities and safe eating practices.
The child demonstrates strong chewing skills, successfully managing chewy foods with proficient oral motor coordination.
The child consistently closes their lips completely, indicating well-developed lip closure necessary for effective eating and speech tasks.
The child shows emerging control of lateral tongue movement but may need further practice to achieve consistent effectiveness.
The child consistently demonstrates the ability to protrude the tongue past the teeth or gums, showing effective control and range of motion of tongue movement.
The child can open their mouth sufficiently for spoon feeding, reflecting adequate oral motor function and readiness for feeding.
The child is able to effectively bite down, indicating strong biting skills and readiness for various textures in feeding.
The child has mastered the ability to move the chin down to the chest, showing good head and neck control crucial for activities like swallowing and posture.
